action.objective: Verify the reserved suggestion e2h5 at full depth to check whether the bishop sortie is sound and safe.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2 gave e2h5 an exact score of 36 as the top candidate, but Black's kingside is uncastled-in-PV and the bishop on h5 can be met by ...g6 or ...O-O with tempo. The reserved verification budget (2000 nodes) exists precisely to test this move's soundness before committing. No commit-ready moves exist yet, so verification is required.
